reading.title: After the Team Presentation
reading.text: After a team presentation, several colleagues react differently. Lina feels happy and proud because the client liked the work, while Samir is grateful for the team's support. Another colleague is excited about the next project. When a last-minute change appears, one person becomes worried and another feels frustrated, but the group stays hopeful.

reading.title: A Long Day at Work
reading.text: After a long shift, Hala feels tired and a little bored while waiting for transport. A delayed message leaves her confused, then a colleague calls with surprising news. During the ride home, she becomes calmer and more relaxed. By the time she arrives, she is still sleepy but alert enough to prepare for the next morning.

reading.title: Checking How You Feel
reading.text: During a busy afternoon, Omar tells a coworker that he feels hungry and thirsty. The room is hot, and after standing for a long time he becomes slightly dizzy, so he sits down and drinks water. Later he feels less tired and more comfortable. His coworker checks that he is okay before they return to work.
